method: Compare the original actual-triangle clipping algorithm with the compact index on all authored national/Paris foundation footprints (including rejected candidates), 50 native recorded tower footprints, plus 800 rotated shoreline/mountain/river/outside footprints. Both polygon windings and ground/crop surfaces; every returned height must be exactly identical. No camera, browser, game or model overrides. CPU authoring timings are not browser load timing.
